title: Establish repository workflow state machine and work-item governance
objective: Establish the repository/process controls required to operate ConstructionOS through the frozen WorkflowOS-derived lifecycle (DRAFT → READY → ASSIGNED → IMPLEMENTING → PR_OPEN → VERIFYING → ARCHITECT_REVIEW → APPROVED → MERGED → VERIFIED), making implementation state auditable and preventing work from being treated as complete without the required evidence.
acceptance_criteria: A canonical workflow/state definition is stored in the repository.
Valid transitions, responsible actors, and required evidence for each terminal state are documented.
At least one sample work item demonstrates full traceability from requirement through verification.
VERIFIED cannot be justified solely by implementation status, screenshots, or narrative claims.
Architecture-version association and Architecture Change Request routing are explicit.
Process definitions are reproducible and inspectable by the Architect.
non_goals: No requirement that all process automation be built before development can begin; documented enforceable controls are the initial target.
ACR template/lifecycle, revision-bound verification invalidation and full lock controls are owned by ARCH-WF-002.
risk_assumptions: Branch protection on main is a repository setting outside version control; until the Product Owner requires the governance status checks, CI enforcement is advisory (documented in governance/README.md).
The validator is the reference implementation of the process and is itself subject to Architect review.

spec/work-items.md carries an older definition of ARCH-WF-001/ARCH-WF-002 than GitHub issues #11/#12; this record follows the issue definitions and the divergence is flagged in the implementation PR for Architect reconciliation (per DEC-001, preserved and not silently reconciled in this PR).
evidence_requirements: Deterministic automated test suite proving state-machine enforcement: legal and illegal transitions, transition ownership, required references, evidence gating for VERIFIED, and re-verification after rejection.
Governance validation run over all repository work-item records (npm run governance -- validate, exit 0).
CI workflow executing tests, governance validation and the protected-path check on every pull request.
A demonstration work item (SAMPLE-001) showing the full traceability chain from requirement through verification, including a verification failure and an architect changes-requested recovery.
